referenceFunction.includedProcesses:
Wind turbine moving parts (without tower and substructure), at site including manufacturing, transports, installation, replacements, decommission and waste treatement. Calculated for FU of 1p. Data of material inputs are based on the offshore wind turbine REpower 5M, with a nominal capacity of 5 MW, as used in the Ormonde offshore wind farm, UK. The distance to installation port is assumed to be 187 km. Assumed lifetime is 25 years.
Main data source regarding material composition: Kouloumpis, V., & Azapagic, A. (2022). A model for estimating life cycle environmental impacts of offshore wind electricity considering specific characteristics of wind farms. Sustainable Production and Consumption, 29, 495–506. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.spc.2021.10.024
referenceFunction.name: Wind turbine 5MW, offshore, moving parts
